title: Split Panes to View Side by Side
trigger: User wants to see two apps or tools in the same cluster at the same time

steps.action: Click the + in the switcher bar and select an app (e.g., File Explorer) to open it
The app appears in a single pane filling the tool window
Click + again and select a different app (e.g., File Viewer) to add a second pane
The two panes split along the longer axis: a wide window splits vertically (left and right), a tall one horizontally (top and bottom)
Drag the line between the panes to resize them, or drag a pane's tab to another pane to move it

outcome: The tool window is divided into two panes, each with its own app, resizable by dragging between them
